reference_basis.use: Treat Holland/RIASEC as vocational interest and person-environment exploration language, not diagnosis, ability proof, hiring suitability, or deterministic career matching.
Keep results framed around work activities users may like and occupations they may explore; do not present occupations as matches, rankings, or recommendations.
Ground thickening in illustrative work activities and occupational task language rather than personality labels or outcome promises.
Interest fit may support exploration and hypothesis generation, but it must not be written as success, performance, admission, hiring, salary, or qualification prediction.

copy_quality_rules: Prefer concrete work activities, tradeoffs, validation questions, and small experiments over labels.
Use zh-CN that sounds like professional career counseling, not machine-generated motivational prose.
Do not thicken by repeating the same boundary paragraph in every section.
When a section is already dense, improve structure and specificity before adding length.
Keep occupation names as examples that illuminate activity signals; never turn them into recommendations.

sections.risk: top3 ordering can read like an identity label
sections.repair_goal: frame the top3 as an activity chain and exploration order, not ability or career conclusion

sections.risk: high or flat bars can be overread as absolute strength or ability
sections.repair_goal: explain relative shape, flatness, near ties, and reading strength

sections.risk: module visibility can expose strong combination copy when a cautious view is safer
sections.repair_goal: align visible/collapsed behavior with quality and profile-shape risk

sections.risk: activity examples can become repetitive, generic, or recommendation-like
sections.repair_goal: make activities concrete, observable, low-risk, and non-deterministic

sections.risk: occupation examples are the highest-risk surface for career recommendation and job-fit claims
sections.repair_goal: keep occupations as examples-only bridges from activity signals

sections.risk: 140Q can be misread as more accurate or as a repair for 60Q
sections.repair_goal: describe 140Q as a contextual detail layer that does not override 60Q

sections.risk: task, environment, and role cards can be over-generalized
sections.repair_goal: make work-daily context specific without comparing raw scores or concluding occupations

sections.risk: public share copy can leak private context or overstate the result
sections.repair_goal: keep share copy minimal, public-safe, and free of score or identity claims

sections.risk: PDF can become too dense or repeat boundaries without adding decision value
sections.repair_goal: compress repeated boundary copy while preserving scientific limits

sections.risk: history can imply stable personality identity instead of a snapshot
sections.repair_goal: show snapshot and exploration history without stable identity claims

sections.risk: feedback can be mistaken as changing scores or Holland code
sections.repair_goal: make feedback affect only exploration actions and never measured results

sections.risk: single dimensions can sound like personality or ability profiles
sections.repair_goal: anchor every dimension in interest activities, costs, misreads, and validation

sections.risk: pair labels can create identity labels
sections.repair_goal: de-label pair copy and thicken tension, cost, and validation

sections.risk: layer copy can drift between task, environment, role, and CTA meanings
sections.repair_goal: make the three 140Q layers consistent and boundary-safe

sections.risk: low-quality copy can blame the user or upsell 140Q
sections.repair_goal: explain cautious reading, retake guidance, and hidden strong modules

sections.risk: 60Q and 140Q differences can be read as better or worse results
sections.repair_goal: describe emphasis differences without raw-score comparison or override

sections.risk: aspiration copy can override measured interest signals
sections.repair_goal: turn aspirations into reality-check questions and small experiments

sections.risk: disagree copy can imply report correction or score mutation
sections.repair_goal: give next steps while preserving snapshot, share, PDF, and measured code
